Limited shower and storm chances, mostly over the higher terrain. - Temperatures bounce back tomorrow, but then average near or even slightly below seasonal normals through next weekend. - Unsettled pattern rest of this week. Thursday

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Tonight and Wednesday... A few isolated showers and storms will be possible over the high terrain this evening, with chances decreasing after midnight. Breezy west-southwest winds (15-20 mph) will be possible late tonight and in the early morning hours, mainly at the mountain tops and ridges. alerts.title: US 40 over Shelton Ditch-143222
alerts.description: Between County Road 51A and Shelton Lane (near Hayden) from Mile Point 108.5 to Mile Point 108.3. Road construction. Starting Thursday at 7:00AM MDT until Thursday, at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • September 17, 7:00AM - September 17, 7:00PM Comment: Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. in order to accommodate the commuter traffic on the US 40 corridor, Monday through Friday. Vehicles will be reduced to a single-lane, alternating traffic intermittently in either direction while the temporary detour is being built. The speed limit will be reduced to 30 mph through the work zone. The project is expected to last until early October. Several other projects are occurring this season on the US 40 corridor. For more information on these projects, please visit: www.cotrip.org

alerts.title: US 40 Milner Resurfacing-143257
alerts.description: Between Moonlight Way (1 mile west of the Steamboat Springs area) and County Road 29 (5 miles west of the Hayden area) from Mile Point 127.3 to Mile Point 100.4. Paving operations. Starting today at 7:00PM MDT until tomorrow at about 6:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • September 15, 7:00PM - September 16, 6:00AM Comment: Work includes barrier placement for the slope stabilization and work on the bridge at MP 113 on the west end of the project limits. Nighttime hours will be 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Vehicles will be reduced to a single-lane, alternating traffic intermittently in either direction, throughout the duration of the project Lane closures, guided by flaggers, will have up to 10-minute delays. The speed limit will be reduced to 40 mph through the work zone. The project is expected to last until the middle of November.
